title: Why Do Bees Matter?
paragraphs: Bees are famous for making honey, but they do something even more important. They help plants make fruit and seeds.
When a bee visits a flower to collect food, a fine powder called pollen sticks to its body. The bee carries the pollen to the next flower. This is called pollination.

Many fruits, vegetables and nuts need pollination by bees and other insects. Apples, cherries, almonds and coffee are some examples. Without them, there would be less food, and it would be more expensive.

Unfortunately, many bees are in danger. They lose the wild places where they live, and some farm chemicals and diseases harm them. People can help by planting flowers and using fewer chemicals in their gardens.
